 For Petitioner : Mr.P.Rajavel  For Respondents : Mr.P.Muthukumar  Additional Advocate General  V  assisted by Mr.M.R.Gokul Krishna  Additional Government Pleader  *****
 ORDER

This writ petition has been filed seeking issuance of a writ of mandamus directing the first respondent to deal with the representations made by the petitioner on 07.09.2022 and 09.12.2022 and to grant compensation to the petitioner as per Sections 26 to 30 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Re-settlement Act, 2013 (Central Act No.30/2013) [hereinafter referred to as 'the Act'].
2.

1997.

sentences.text: Thereafter, the District Collector determined the compensation through proceedings dated 12.10.2022 and passed an award.

The petitioner was not satisfied with the compensation that was fixed and hence, a representation was made to the first respondent to the effect that the petitioner is receiving the compensation fixed by the first respondent on protest.
The petitioner also requested the first respondent to re-consider and award compensation as claimed by the petitioner.
Since the same was not considered, the present writ petition has been filed before this Court.
4. In the considered view of this Court, the first respondent has exercised his jurisdiction under Section 7(3) of the Act.
Any person, who is aggrieved by the decision of the Collector can request for reference to Court within a period of 60 days from the date on which the decision is conveyed.
There is no question of District Collector once again re- determining the compensation award.
The award was passed on 12.10.2022 and the representations have been given by the petitioner objecting to the compensation fixed within the time frame.

In view of the same, there shall be a direction to the first respondent to refer the matter before the civil Court within a period of four (4) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
Thereafter, it is left open to the petitioner to agitate before the civil Court and seek for enhancement of compensation.
